question:
• I would like to view the entire sql that dbt is going to execute with dbt run / dbt build.
  • dbt compile just generates the SELECT SQL's that are present in dbt models. They do not generate the SQL headers like INSERT INTO / MERGE INTO / COPY INTO / CTAS.
  • The above can be seen under target/run only after a dbt build is run.
  • Now, I would like to view these compile sql before running the model so as to not audit the sqls better.
title: DBT view entire generated sql along with sql headers, macros and hooks - dry run
answer:
dbt show --select my_model --limit n_result_rows

# the command help has an inline option

dbt show --inline "select * from {{ ref('my_model') }}"

dbt docs: dbt show. As noted in docs, this will not materialize the data or store results in a file, only in logs and stdout.

I found this is great for debugging sql_header configs, which will silently fail on syntax errors.

AFAICT the dbt run wont store this sql_header information in target/run/../my_model.sql, nor in ./target/run_results.json, even after running the model.
